```json
 "topology": "StrongARM latch + output inverters",
 "rationale": "StrongARM has no static current, so energy is only switched C*VDD^2. One 10 fF output toggles per decision (about 32 fJ). Small L=0.15 internal devices add about 15-25 fF more, giving roughly 70-85 fJ total. Regeneration time constant: C_int/gm_latch is about 5 fF/0.6 mS, under 10 ps. ln(VDD/(Av*1mV)) is about 6 time constants, so about 60 ps, plus about 30 ps for the inverters, under 150 ps. All internal nodes are reset to VDD by PMOS switches during clk low."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wtail": (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),    # tail switch width [um]
    "Win":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),    # input pair width [um]
    "Wln":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),    # latch nfet width [um]
    "Wlp":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),    # latch pfet width [um]
    "Wrst":  (0.5, 0.42, 1.5),    # reset pfet width [um]
    "Wbn":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),    # output inverter nfet [um]
    "kp":    (2.5, 1.5, 4.0),     # output inverter pfet/nfet width ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 1e-3)
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # tail switch (evaluate when clk high)
    n.M("M0", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch: vinp>vinn -> xn falls, xp stays high
    n.M("M3", "xn", "xp", "dp", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xp", "xn", "dn", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    # reset switches on all internal nodes (clk low -> VDD)
    n.M("M7", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("M8", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("M9", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("M10", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    # output inverters: outp = NOT(xn), outn = NOT(xp); both low during reset
    Wbp = p["kp"] * p["Wbn"]
    n.M("M11", "outp", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbn"], L)
    n.M("M12", "outp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, L)
    n.M("M13", "outn", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbn"], L)
    n.M("M14", "outn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cpu = 1.0e-15  # ~1 fF/um (gate + junction), L=0.15
    c_x = cpu * (p["Wln"] + p["Wlp"]) * 1.5 + cpu * p["Wrst"] + cpu * (p["Wbn"] + Wbp)
    c_d = cpu * (0.5 * p["Win"] + 0.5 * p["Wln"] + 0.5 * p["Wrst"])
    # latch transconductance at mid-rail (n+p), approx
    on = lut.op("n", p["Wln"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_ = lut.op("p", p["Wlp"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    tau = max(c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-9), 1e-12)
    # input-pair integration phase
    oi = lut.op("n", p["Win"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
    t_int = c_d * 0.7 / max(oi["Id"], 1e-9) + c_x * 0.8 / max(oi["Id"], 1e-9)
    av = max(oi["gm"] * t_int / max(c_x, 1e-18), 2.0)
    t_regen = tau * math.log(vdd / (av * dv))
    # output inverter delay (pfet drives CL up)
    ob = lut.op("p", Wbp, L, 1.8, 0.9)
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + cpu * (p["Wbn"] + Wbp)) * 0.9 / max(ob["Id"], 1e-9) * 1.5
    delay = t_int * 0.5 + t_regen + t_inv

    # energy: one output toggles; latch side + both d-nodes recharge
    c_sw = cl + cpu * (p["Wbn"] + Wbp) + c_x + 2 * c_d + 0.5 * c_x
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
